pkgmetadata.longdescription: SMG (Shared Model Gateway) is an engine-agnostic LLM gateway written in Rust. It provides full OpenAI and Anthropic API compatibility across multiple backends including SGLang, vLLM, TRT-LLM, OpenAI, and Gemini. Features include gRPC pipeline, KV cache-aware routing, chat history, tokenization caching, embeddings, WASM plugins, MCP, and multi-tenant auth.
